text_block_list.text:
One day, I get an idea to address Biwa

Hayahide's anxiety by setting up a
scrimmage
between her and Winning
Ticket.
text_block_list.name: Монолог

text_block_list.text:
Бива Хаяхидэ loses, but her loss
facilitates a
major breakthrough. She
realizes she started
creating her
equation because of a desire not to
lose
to her sister, Нарита Брайан.
text_block_list.name: Монолог

text_block_list.text: Success, though, isn't just about not losing. It's about winning. So we resolve to create a real winning equation from scratch... hopefully in time for the Kikuka Sho.
text_block_list.name: Монолог

text_block_list.text:
Уиннинг Тикит and Нарита Таисин give
their full
support.
text_block_list.name: Монолог
